text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Early May, the day of the NHK Mile Cup. 
Air Messiah and I made a sudden decision 
to enter, and were waiting for the main 
event in the waiting room.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"It ended up being quite an overambitious 
schedule, but it was a decision we made 
together. We had only one goal: 'To test 
Rhein Kraft's true strength'—"

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Even in her previous race, the Oka Sho, 
Craft-san ran with such power, as if 
declaring that mile races are truly her 
domain.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
And on top of that, this... declaration to 
run in the NHK Mile Cup.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
No Umamusume has ever transitioned from 
the Tiara route to the NHK Mile Cup and 
won.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"The NHK Mile Cup is a race where the 
fastest umamusume of the same generation 
gather, regardless of the Triple Crown or 
Tiara route, to determine who is the 
strongest at the mile distance."

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"Truly—one cannot be a victor without 
possessing the speed worthy of being 
called the 'fastest of the era.'"

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
choice_data_list:
I came here brimming with confidence that 
I am the fastest of this era...

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
That is highly likely. ...She is not the 
type of person to recklessly take on a 
challenge without thinking.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"Someone who longed for the Tiara so 
intensely... has chosen the NHK Mile Cup 
instead of the Yushun Himba (Oaks), 
carving her own path forward."

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Just how powerful has that running become 
now?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
...Has it truly come to pass, I wonder? I 
believe I must confirm it with my own 
body.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Or perhaps Daring Heart, who also declared 
her entry, might be thinking along the 
same lines.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"Even if she doesn't run in the Oaks... 
there's a strong chance Craft-san will 
make her comeback to the Tiara route this 
autumn in the Shuka Sho."
choice_data_list: To be ready for that moment—

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"...To verify, and to prepare. I shall 
take my leave now."
